label: end-of-episode (low value) D1 fixation and a2->S1 rare D2
explanation: Episode-end timing unit. Fires only in the last ~15 trials of the 100-trial episode (0 activations before trial 80; 96% of mass in trials 90-99), equivalently when the model value head is low (value < 5.22 holds 99.4% of mass). Within that window it fires at D1 (77% of mass) and at D2 almost only after a2 led rarely to S1; it is essentially silent at GO and at D2 after a1 or a2->S2. Magnitude ramps up across consecutive trials toward the episode end (e.g. 0.71, 0.78, 0.80 in successive D1s of one window) and is larger in a2-choosing streaks; D1 FPs are mostly in a1 streaks (adding action==2 raises precision to 0.77 but lowers recall, F1 about equal). Recorded predicate uses only the model value (observed/computed) and phase/observed inputs; ep_trial >= 90 gives a similar but slightly worse F1 (0.70). Precision is incomplete (~0.65) because D1 steps late in a1-choosing episodes are often inactive.
